run_test_split_vad: run the unit tests for the split_vad voice activity detection segmentation function
test_split_all_silence: test that split_vad returns no segments when all silence probabilities are above threshold
test_split_all_speech: test that split_vad returns a single segment spanning the full range when all speech
test_split_short_speech: test that split_vad filters out speech segments shorter than the length threshold
test_split_short_silence: test that split_vad merges speech segments separated by silence shorter than the length threshold
